description: Hear the same relative-note patterns under C-major slot 1 for two bars, then D-major slot 2 for two bars. Doubledecker plays upper degrees 0, 0, 0 and 1; Polyperc 1 plays bass degrees 0 and 4 at octave minus 1. Note masks remain X. The rhythms and velocities stay fixed while the applied scale changes the pitches.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: Changing Harmony with Scale Slots
